verdict.rationale: Lambda's Cloud API OpenAPI spec documents webhook notifications sent to a user-supplied URL, but only for support ticket events. There is no evidence of webhooks for instance, cluster, billing or other infrastructure lifecycle events that an AI-native workflow would most need. Missing for 10: webhooks for instance and cluster lifecycle events (e.g., launched, SSH-ready, terminated), documentation of the subscription and management API, payload and signature details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
